description: Version 3 weight: prefix bytes + ceil(prunable bytes / 4); a block's weight is the sum of its transactions'. Block limits, the median and the oversize penalty are version 2's functions of weight; the minimum fee is version 2's formula with FEE_REFERENCE_WEIGHT 1000 (version 2: 3000), of the REAL size and the (weight) median.
name: v3_weight

transactions.note: prunable bytes a multiple of 4 plus 1 (401: weight rounds up)
